domain_title: Architecture, security, robustness, safety and evaluation
title: Fail-open AI operation
canonical_definition: When confidence, controls, components or evidence fail, the system continues without safe limitation.

conditions: All systems; stronger requirements for autonomous, safety-relevant, high-availability or consequential uses.
Record the assessed release, operating scope and evidence that supports any applicability decision.

primary_questions.question: Does the case exhibit Fail-open AI operation: When confidence, controls, components or evidence fail, the system continues without safe limitation.
Do implemented workflows, data paths or operations show errors becoming plausible outputs, control outages bypassing validation, or undefined rollback?
Does current evidence test presence or scoped absence of Fail-open AI operation, or does it remain unknown?

antipattern_indicators: Rollback or manual takeover is undefined

conditions: Refer verified fail-open ai operation to the accountable authority before progression where the condition materially affects the requested operating scope.

normative_source_mappings.relevant_locator: NIST AI 100-1, MEASURE 2.6 (PDF p. 35), MANAGE 2.3 (PDF p. 37), MANAGE 2.4 (PDF p. 37)
normative_source_mappings.mapping_rationale: The voluntary framework provides guidance on evaluating safety and planning response, recovery and disengagement. The SAE criteria define the object-specific rules. Confirm any binding obligation through the accountable authority and its applicable source.

failure_mechanism: The declared or implemented control can be unreliable where a known component or control failure has no defined safe response or recovery owner. The mechanism can have an operational effect where a failure converts into an apparently valid result, or validation is bypassed while decisions continue.
potential_consequences: An unsafe or unsupported output can be used during an uncontained failure.

atomic_tests.test: Compare the effective governance and design records. Determine whether a known component or control failure has no defined safe response or recovery owner. Identify the system scope and the record that supports each conclusion.

Trace actual configurations or activity for the assessed release. Determine whether a failure converts into an apparently valid result, or validation is bypassed while decisions continue. Attribute each observation to the specific path, time and decision.

Independently review execute controlled fault cases for unavailable dependencies, missing evidence and incomplete recovery, then verify safe state and restoration. Record whether each material mechanism was tested, the observed result and the scope limitations.

required_evidence.title: Effective design and governance records
required_evidence.description: Review the versioned owner decision and relevant specifications for evidence of whether a known component or control failure has no defined safe response or recovery owner. Preserve material conflict and applicability context.

required_evidence.title: Observed condition or enforcement trace
required_evidence.description: Use effective configuration or dated operational records to determine whether a failure converts into an apparently valid result, or validation is bypassed while decisions continue. Identify the version, affected paths and period represented.

required_evidence.title: Executed scoped comparison
required_evidence.description: Provide execute controlled fault cases for unavailable dependencies, missing evidence and incomplete recovery, then verify safe state and restoration. Include current scope, expected results, observed results, retained evidence and unresolved cases.

required_evidence.title: Independent review and limitations
required_evidence.description: An independent reviewer confirms the assessed version, completeness of coverage, result, limitations and whether a material change requires a new test.

required_artifacts: Execute controlled fault cases for unavailable dependencies, missing evidence and incomplete recovery, then verify safe state and restoration.
Current version and scope with all material failure paths and cases identified.
Expected and observed results, attributable records, and independent review of coverage and residual limitations.

sufficiency: Presence requires affirmative evidence for a material mechanism. Examine whether a known component or control failure has no defined safe response or recovery owner, and separately check whether a failure converts into an apparently valid result, or validation is bypassed while decisions continue. A supported mechanism may establish presence within its evidenced scope.
Keep unresolved or contradictory mechanisms UNKNOWN and preserve the competing records. Refer material interpretation conflicts to the accountable human authority.

Use TESTED_ABSENT only after a current, executed, successful and independently verified evaluation covers all material paths within scope. Use execute controlled fault cases for unavailable dependencies, missing evidence and incomplete recovery, then verify safe state and restoration. Reassess when material changes affect that scope.
evidence_rules.evidence_ceiling: A document can identify a declared gap. Effective configuration can demonstrate a reachable condition. Observed records support only their covered period and workflow. TESTED_ABSENT requires the complete scoped absence contract.
false_positive_guards: A fallback is justified when the permitted degraded scope, control checks and accountable recovery route are evidenced.
Confirm that the observed or alleged condition applies to the current assessed release and a reachable path.
prohibited_inferences: A gap or UNKNOWN in D5 alone cannot establish AP-D5 presence.
Missing complaints, incident silence and unsuccessful collection cannot establish absence.
Model output and tactic selection grant no authority to approve, close a finding or accept risk.

finding_definitions.title: Design or intent shows fail-open ai operation
Implementation or operating evidence shows fail-open ai operation
Presence or tested absence of fail-open ai operation is unresolved within scope
